reason: Fresh-main Release Audit V2 confirms Known Finding KF-P1-08 remains active at main 7802e99d759edb7c2210d49bf8a09142da9217c6. Persona compilation exposes conflicting runtime semantics: compiler.js still names profile-only compileContext as the canonical runtime entry, createPersonaBrain exposes both compileContext and compileEffectiveContext, contextAwareReplyBrain prefers compileEffectiveContext but falls back to compileContext, and the public /:profileId/compile-context route directly selects profile-only compileContext. Because compileEffectiveContext resolves global/contact/conversation bindings while compileContextForProfile does not, callers can bypass scoped Persona authority. This work package locks the ambiguity with one mandatory WP0 causal contract and converges only the three already-proven runtime call seams onto compileEffectiveContext while preserving the low-level pure compiler primitive, Persona persistence, validators, truth firewall, candidate/outbox binding, AI gateway, and HTTP endpoint identity.
